answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 162473 Country: JAPAN Title: In the time of fast using soaps when bathing, using cream or lotion in the body is permissible? Question: In the time of fast using soaps when bathing, using cream or lotion in the body is permissible? Answer ID: 162473 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1165/1056/M=9/1439) One may use soap, cream or lotion while taking a bath in the state of fast, it will not invalidate the fast. Just take care that you don’t exaggerate in gargling and putting water in the nose. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
